related.title: PETSc：Neumann 零空間與相容右端項
related.titleEn: PETSc: Neumann nullspaces and compatible right-hand sides
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：常數保持與界面連續皆通過；限制適用範圍寫入交接。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Constant preservation and interface continuity both pass, with element-specific scope recorded in the handover.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「PETSc：Neumann 零空間與相容右端項」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付零空間驗證、相容性帳本、雙殘差與規範選擇說明。
related.differenceEn: Investigate PETSc: Neumann nullspaces and compatible right-hand sides using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver nullspace verification, compatibility ledgers, both residual definitions and a gauge-selection statement documenting any change to the mathematical problem.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 用權重 0.75、0.25 算基線，再用斜率四核算；保留端點、方向與位置。
b=[2,0] 的平均為一，移除 [1,1] 得 [1,−1]；算移除向量範數並保留原資料。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute the baseline with weights 0.75 and 0.25 and independently check it using slope four. Preserve endpoints, orientation and position so the arithmetic can be reconstructed without the mesh software.

Find mean one for b=[2,0], remove [1,1] and obtain [1,-1]. Compute the removed-vector norm while retaining the original load, making the mathematical modification visible rather than overwriting its provenance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ARPACK：位移反轉映射與原問題殘差
related.titleEn: ARPACK: shift-invert mappings and original-problem residuals
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：常數保持與界面連續皆通過；限制適用範圍寫入交接。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Constant preservation and interface continuity both pass, with element-specific scope recorded in the handover.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ARPACK：位移反轉映射與原問題殘差」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付雙向譜映射、位移矩陣對角值、原殘差與接近奇異的反例。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ARPACK: shift-invert mappings and original-problem residuals using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver forward and inverse spectral mappings, shifted diagonal entries, original residuals and a near-singularity counterexample showing why transformed magnitude is not an accuracy certificate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 用權重 0.75、0.25 算基線，再用斜率四核算；保留端點、方向與位置。
以差值 0.5 得 μ=2，再用 σ+1/μ 回復五；計另一特徵值二的映射以確認目標區域。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute the baseline with weights 0.75 and 0.25 and independently check it using slope four. Preserve endpoints, orientation and position so the arithmetic can be reconstructed without the mesh software.
Use difference 0.5 to obtain mu=2 and recover five through the inverse map. Also transform eigenvalue two, comparing magnitudes to understand why the targeted eigenvalue becomes prominent.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
